android.desc:
Quick is a screen recorder that allows you to record the screen of your device. The powerful tool for video screen capture and record sound.Quick share screen videos.
The best easy to use screen recorder app with one action to start and stop recording. Record screen with sound and comment your game and gameplay.

- HIGH-QUALITY video: up to 1080p Resolution, 15 Mbps Quality, 60 FPS
- FREE video recorder
- Start screen recording of games and apps with overlay button
- Shake device to stop recording screen
- Record audio and your voice with the mic
- Built-in replays gallery
- Multiple videos recording – you can record one video, stop recording and immediately start a new recording with overlay button
- Selecting the directory for storing the screen recordings
- Quick video sharing using pop-up notifications
- NO root required
- Video chat recording

Record games videos like Clash Royal, Minecraft, FIFA Mobile and share replays with your friends.
